reviews.text: I was going to feed my pet but they had to go hungry as in 15 seconds flat the insanely predatory company they use to police their lot even after hours stole 170 bucks from me. Just not it queens.

This was my (and my cat’s) first time going to Kriser’s for their grooming services. I have to say, I was very pleasantly surprised.

I have a 10 year old cat that’s truly a dream, and an adorable yet unhinged 2 year old cat that has to be part tiger. However, the groomer on staff, Matthew was INCREDIBLE with both!

I shared that one would be easy and the other has to mildly sedated due to her spiciness, even for a nail trim. So I’d completely understand if he couldn’t trim the 2 year old’s nails. He took on the challenge, (with a peer) and got them both done with no issues.

Matthew was also just super sweet. There was another woman at the register who was also incredibly personable and made the trip well worth it.

Many many thanks to Matthew and his associates.
We will be back.
Everyone there was so kind and friendly. Me and my dogs were very happy.
The most terrible grooming experience.

Horrible place - Do not shop here. They will tow your car and boot your car and send sketchy men with dented cars to boot your car. Then. when you try to go pay for the boot, they scam you and refuse your payment and tow your car costing thousands of extra customers. THEY LOST A VALUED CUSTOMER. This place is horrible. Not only did management watch my car get towed after I said I was a customer but they did nothing to help. What a scam and why would a blue collar worker do this.
Lol the dog know exactly how to get here from the house. Wonderful place very friendly and helpful with everything.
Good prices on my Wellness cat food, and good customer service
Go to the River North location instead.

It’s not any one thing that makes Kriser’s so great, but it’s the whole vibe and wonderful assortment of products. For as long as I’ve been shopping at Kriser’s, it’s consistently the friendly, knowledgeable & pet loving staff that keeps me coming back! 🐶 💜 🐱 …

Liz is our go-to girl, and she’s absolutely wonderful with my Herbie. He can be a bit of a grumpy gremlin and doesn’t always trust people—especially when it comes to his paws and nails—but Liz makes everything feel easy and stress-free.

We love her calming energy and the way she puts him at ease. The whole staff is always kind, treats are a bonus, and the store is consistently clean and well organized. We always leave happy!

Halo and I love coming here because of the warm and friendly staff. We frequent more than once a day on our walks. Halo gets very excited when we walk in. At least now we know where to find him if he ever runs away LOL.
Great healthy selection. Helpful team
My dog loves the food from Fromm
Can't say enough about the friendly staff and great selection of pet items. Great and convenient location in Bucktown!
Been taking my dogs here for 5 years because of the amazing staff and wonderful grooming salon. 10/10 my dogs love this place as much as I am grateful for it.

I came into the store and the store attendant was so helpful, professional, and most important loving to my sweet baby girl who was definitely shaking her down for treats!! She helped me set up my account, helped me with my purchase, gave me information about the self wash bundles, helped me find Nulo products and was an overall joy and breath of fresh air! I wouldn't say I have ever had a negative experience at any Kriser's location,  but this location is definitely superb in terms of their customer service! Pictures of the little nugget attached.
Expensive
Great staff + grooming services!

I scheduled an appointment for my dog at the self wash station. When I got there, the self wash station was in use at the time of my appointment. The staff member at the desk told me that they do a lot of walk-ins and don’t honor self wash appointment times. I typically go to the river north location, which is great with appointments. They also have one tub which is great for reactive dogs. My dog is reactive and that is why I booked an appointment so she could have the space to herself. I had never been to the Bucktown location, but it is closer to my house so I wanted to try it. I am very disappointed that my appointment was not honored. Marketing must be updated and appointments should not be accepted at this location if you are not going to honor them.
Matt is so wonderful with our senior dog.  So kind, gentle.  The best!
Love the staff, and the groomer Junior are fantastic!
very nice, my dog and i enjoyed the bath : )
The staff is always knowledgeable and friendly!
The best!
I love their natural selections. I'll always recommend.

The pet food is actually healthy and the cashiers are extremely helpful, in particular Alphonzo was amazing, he helped me find what I was looking for and I told him my doggo has a tummy ache and he recommended pumpkin, really knows his stuff!

I’ve been bringing my cavapoo, Mylo, to Kriser’s for two years and have always had positive experiences—until recently. Unfortunately, since Junior began grooming at this location, the quality of service has noticeably gone downhill.

The first red flag was during a full-service grooming appointment. Despite me regularly brushing and maintaining Mylo’s coat to prevent matting, Junior insisted on shaving him down without even examining him first. While I ultimately agreed to the shave for the sake of Mylo being tended to, I specifically requested that he leave a thin layer of hair to help protect Mylo from the weather. Instead, Mylo was returned to me completely shaved down to the skin. To make matters worse, his ears were still full of wax and hair. When I expressed my concerns, Junior simply stated, “this was the best I could do,” but agreed to go back and clean the ears, which is something that should have been done the first time.

Giving the benefit of doubt due to limited availability, I gave Junior another chance for a basic face, feet, fanny trim and nail grind package. Although the website said it should be a 40 minute appointment, Junior said it’d only take 10 minutes. When he returned Mylo, only the hair around his eyes and his sanitary areas had been trimmed, but nothing had been done to his muzzle or paws.
When I asked about the muzzle and eyebrows specifically, he insisted that “face” only refers to the area around the eyes. It doesn’t take a rocket scientist to know that this is simply not true, especially for poodle mixes with rapid hair growth. He argued for 5 minutes that this was proper protocol. Since we couldn’t agree, we had to interrupt another groomer mid-service for him to clarify and confirm more trimming was required. He reiterated that the muzzle and eyebrows were indeed included in “face”. Even then, Junior left a significant amount of hair requiring me to request corrections multiple times. His excuse? He was ready to leave and didn’t have time to continuously go over his face without additional payment.

The final result was still incomplete. Mylo left with half of his muzzle tended to, full chin hair and a significant amount of hair between the paw pads. Junior’s reasoning for not completing the paws was that his clippers were getting dirty because Mylo needed a bath. At that point, I asked the front desk for help. A guy informed me that they weren’t knowledgeable about grooming specifics and for any discrepancies, I was left to deal with Junior again. Trying once more, he spoke with him on my behalf and Junior reiterated that he had done all he was willing to do.

Junior came across as confrontational, dismissive and lazy considering that he was unwilling to perform even the basics of grooming services. I am extremely disappointed in the subpar services I have received not once, but twice. Mylo deserves better and so do all of the clients at Kriser’s. I’ve read the reviews. This is not the first and I’m sure won’t be the last comment on his bare minimum performance. I’m disheartened. I would hate to have to part ways with Kriser’s as a whole.
Knowledgeable staff.  Very friendly and eager to help.  Never feel like I'm bothering staff here.  They genuinely care about animals and know the best things in the store for different concerns.

Didn’t have a great experience the first time w the groomer but drove here again to get my dog groomed only to be told “the manager switched the schedule around and I’d have to wait another 45 mins”. Basically wasted my time after getting repeated messages to be at the store on time. No call. No text. Nothing.
My dog loves going to Krisers!

This is by far the cutest Kriser’s in Chicago! They go above and beyond to decorate for every holiday! Absolutely love going here to see all of the new decorations and events they have going on.

On top of that they’re incredibly informative on new products and have the nicest people working here!

Thanks for the enjoyable experience!

The Bucktown location is the best! They are always kind and helpful, and I know I can trust the products they are selling. Dune loves stopping by!

They gave us a “Gotcha Day” cookie on her adoption day, and she passed out surrounded by her new toys from there!
Very friendly and attentive staff. From the moment you walk in till you're ready to check out. Great store!
Big assortment of products and the staff is always friendly and professional.

I used the self-wash option here, and booking online was quick and easy. All I had to do was agree to the terms and upload a vaccination document.
The wash station was clean and spacious, and it included shampoo, conditioner, two towels, an air dryer, and aprons to help you stay clean.
I only saw two self-wash stations available. It was $15 and they had a $5 off special. I will for sure be returning !

Went in today around 12:15pm with my pup for the Summer Pawlooza event we were emailed about. We were thoroughly disappointed in the lack of anything. The email and event page on the Kriser’s website listed frozen dog treats, samples, and raffle for a $100 goodie basket. The event page online stated the event was “all day.” The store had a table set up in the front with balloons and streamers, but nothing else.

I asked one of the workers if they had the items for the event, and he looked confused and went on to help another customer with zero interest in looking into the event they were supposed to be hosting. I asked a different worker, and he stated that he needed to “go get the raffle sign” and proceeded to walk around the store for 10 minutes before I gave up and left.

A word of advice, don’t email your mailing list advertising an event if you aren’t going to properly run it. There were no frozen dog treats, samples, or the ability to enter the $100 goodie basket raffle. Just a lousy table with balloons and more flyers listing the same info as their website. Embarrassing.

I'm so impressed with the Kriser Natural Pet Food store and have had nothing but fantastic experiences shopping there. From the moment you walk in, the staff is incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to help. They clearly have a deep passion for providing the best products and care for pets.

The rewards program is also a huge perk - I love earning points with each purchase that I can put towards future items. It makes stocking up on my pet's favorite natural foods and treats even more rewarding.

The store itself is clean, well-organized, and carries a wide variety of high-quality, healthy options. I always feel confident that I'm getting the best for my furry family member when I shop at Kriser. The staff takes the time to understand your pet's individual needs and makes thoughtful recommendations.

Overall, Kriser Natural Pet Food has exceeded my expectations in every way. The combination of their amazing customer service, impressive product selection, and generous rewards program keeps me coming back again and again. I highly recommend this store to any pet parent looking for a one-stop shop for premium, natural pet supplies.
Love the self wash area! Dryers could be better...only blow cold air
Great customer service and deals.
Beware of parking lot. I purchased from Krisers and walked across the street after and got a boot on my car within 2 mins. There is a guy sitting in his vehicle watching everyone!
Paul, thanks for the 5 stars! See you next time!
Amazing selection.  Best manager.  Help me find exactly what I needed.
Jose, thanks for the 5 stars! See you soon!
LOVE THIS STORE! Staff is always friendly and helpful.  They always try and get to know their human and fur customers with a little chit chat.  Love it! Thank you!
Great Customer Service!

We have loved sending our dog Teddy to Matt over the past couple of years for grooming! He is so kind and has always done an amazing job grooming and caring for our very anxious and curly-haired maltipoo.

Krisers is our main pet store for several reasons. Not only is it conveniently located near our place, but the staff has always been a joy to work with whether we're getting grooming or just our regular food order. The selection of products is fantastic and I like the rewards program.

Now that I’ve had time to cool off, please avoid this place all cost!! I had a 2:30pm grooming appointment yesterday for my 8lb havanese. I just chose the groomer who had availability, and went against my better judgement because the groomer that was assigned (Junior) looked incredible sketchy online. I arrived to my appointment early around 2:20pm, and before he even touched my dog, he said she was matted. She was not matted AT ALL, I literally combed/dematted her the night before. However, he insisted on taking her to the back and doing a quick blow dry to check for matting. He came back and said the COLLAR area was matted and that there would be an extra charge. I said whatever because the collar area does get matted often. So my dog was brought to the back at 2:30pm on the dot and I went about my way. At 4:08pm, I had a missed call/voicemail from him advising that she was matted in the middle of her back and needed to be shaved. I let them know that I did not want her shaved/was on my way to get her because it’s the middle of freaking winter and I didn’t want my dog to be cold. I live less than 10 minutes away from there and got there around 4:20pm to pick her up. When I got there, they kept asking me if I could come back tomorrow because she wasn’t in a good state. They bring her out to me, and she was partially groomed on her back. I then told them to just go ahead and shave her because she looked kind of crazy. The groomer then proceeded to tell me that my dog was his last appointment of the day and that he was off at 5pm and couldn’t do it. Mind you, the appointment was at 2:30pm and he didn’t start until 4pm, and now he doesn’t have time to shave my tiny dog? You cannot make this up!! Then later that day, my husband called and proceeded to give them a piece of his mind and they said that I signed a waiver which authorized them to shave my dog. Yes, I did sign the waiver (because I had to), so why didn’t they just shave her before calling me? And why didn’t they tell me that they started grooming her on the voicemail? Also, the groomer blow dried her earlier and only said her collar area was matted, then all of a sudden her back was matted too? The entire staff is shady and grimey!!! Also, they kept referring to my dog as ‘he’ even though she was clearly a girl with a bright pink collar AND they never asked for my vaccine forms. That stuff seems minor, but it goes to show that they’re in the grooming business only to make money, they do not care about dogs!!! Luckily, PetSmart was able to fix her up the next day - and they said she was NOT MATTED.

Similar to another review, we took our Havanese in to be groomed only to be told that she was too matted & that they’d need to shave her down completely. No ask for approval, simply began shaving without consent. We live nearby & my wife ran over to find our dog half-shaven already.

I stress to anyone reading this, DO NOT give your money to this place. Completely irresponsible behavior & they do not belong in the neighborhood.
Sandy, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you next time!
Lauren, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you next time!

i took my dog to get groomed here a few months ago. they texted me the day of asking if i was able to switch grooming times and i said yes but let them know i was going to be 5 minutes late due to another appointment i had before hand which they said was fine. i get there probably 5-7 minutes late like i warned them and then i had to wait 20 minutes after i arrived for the groomer to come out as they were finishing up another dog.  the groomer says they won’t be able to do the full service groom because of how late i was. we then begin to go back forth after i explained that i switched grooming times to accommodate them and they said it would be fine to be 5 minutes late. he began blaming me when he very clearly went over his time with the previous dog. they were able to do a very quick grooming on him which i was very appreciative of and was charged the full service groom price and tipped 40% on the service for them being able to fit him in. two days later, my dog was in a ton of pain so i rushed him to the vet and they said it was because his anal glands had not been expressed. i then called krisers and asked if the full service grooming included anal gland expression which they said yes to. i let them know i had to take my dog to the vet due to not having his anal gland expressed during his grooming appointment, and the vet gave me a note for them saying this wouldn’t have happened if they would have expressed them in the first place. the employee i spoke to said she would connect with the groomer and have the manager call me back the next day to which i still have not heard back from. very disappointed in this experience  as we have been to multiple krisers for grooming and they have always been great. after this experience i will not be back and suggest taking your dog else where for grooming.
